new_candidates.date_enacted: City Council voted 9-0 to adopt Ordinance 2313 on second and final reading, 2026-07-07.
new_candidates.duration: Stops acceptance, pre-submittal activity, and processing for new or expanded data center facilities and other large energy users with projected loads of at least 10 MW. The pause lasts 18 months from its effective date, or until relevant municipal definitions and standards are adopted, whichever occurs first; council retained authority to extend it. Effective seven days after publication following final passage.

Scheduled to expire January 7, 2027, or when the county adopts permanent regulations, whichever occurs first.
